model: 3-D axisymmetric source-ring BEM; sharp disk and Riabouchinsky image closure
limitations: Inverse fixed-length model: ambient pressure and cavitation number are solved, not independently prescribed.
Unbounded steady inviscid axial flow; no tunnel blockage, viscosity, gravity, surface tension or nuclei model.
Artificial downstream image body; its cancelling pressure force is not the physical disk drag.
All finite collocation and quarter-panel samples are retained; tiny collocation residual does not establish off-grid or experimental accuracy.
First-order constant-source conical bands; sharp-detachment sampling remains discretization-sensitive.
No claim of validated developed-cavity accuracy until matched external data and independent formulation/refinement pass.
